name: caption_batch
description: Walk a folder of images, caption each one with the Caption module, and write a sidecar .txt next to each image. Returns counts and a sample of generated captions.
expected_effect: Writes a .txt caption file next to every image in the target folder. Reversible by deleting the .txt files (the source images are untouched). With overwrite=true, replaces any existing .txt files in the folder.

parameters.name: folder
parameters.description: Absolute path to a folder of images

parameters.name: trigger
parameters.description: Optional trigger word prefix prepended to every caption

parameters.name: backend
parameters.description: Force a backend: florence | qwen | joycaption
